SELECT s.store_key, s.store_id, s.store_name, s.city, s.valid_from, s.valid_to, s.is_current, s.close_date, p.product_key, p.sku, p.product_name, p.category, p.valid_from AS pvf, p.valid_to AS pvt, p.is_current AS pcur, p.delisted_on
FROM dim_store s CROSS JOIN dim_product p
WHERE (s.store_name ILIKE '%Palokka%' OR s.city ILIKE '%Palokka%') AND p.sku = 100011
ORDER BY 1,9

calls.statement:
SELECT week_ending_date, store_key, product_key, closing_units, closing_value, receipts_units, adjustment_units, etl_loaded_at
FROM fact_stock_week
WHERE store_key = 30 AND product_key = 11 AND week_ending_date >= DATE '2026-08-30'
ORDER BY week_ending_date, etl_loaded_at

SELECT fs.week_ending_date, count(*) AS rows_all, count(DISTINCT (fs.store_key, fs.product_key)) AS keys, max(fs.etl_loaded_at) AS loaded,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_stock_week x JOIN dim_store xs ON xs.store_key=x.store_key JOIN dim_product xp ON xp.product_key=x.product_key WHERE x.week_ending_date=fs.week_ending_date AND xs.store_id=124 AND xp.sku=100011) AS n_target,
  (SELECT coalesce(sum(l.quantity),0) FROM fact_sales_line l JOIN dim_store ls ON ls.store_key=l.store_key JOIN dim_product lp ON lp.product_key=l.product_key WHERE ls.store_id=124 AND lp.sku=100011 AND l.sale_date BETWEEN fs.week_ending_date-6 AND fs.week_ending_date) AS units_sold,
  (SELECT coalesce(sum(r.quantity_returned),0) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store rs ON rs.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product rp ON rp.product_key=r.product_key WHERE rs.store_id=124 AND rp.sku=100011 AND r.return_date BETWEEN fs.week_ending_date-6 AND fs.week_ending_date) AS units_returned
FROM fact_stock_week fs
WHERE fs.week_ending_date >= DATE '2026-09-06'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT cs.store_id, cs.store_name, cp.sku, cp.product_name, fs.week_ending_date, SUM(fs.closing_units) AS closing_units
FROM fact_stock_week fs
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = fs.store_key
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fs.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE cs.store_id = 124 AND cp.sku = 100011 AND fs.week_ending_date = DATE '2026-10-04'
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5
